verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents time-off request APIs covering balance checking, submission, admin approval or decline, and payroll integration, so the approvals-to-payroll part of the story is supported. Nothing in the pack shows how an ops user would define PTO policies or configure accrual rules, and the depth of the automatic payroll application is only stated, not detailed. Missing for 10: documented PTO policy creation, accrual rule configuration, detail on how approved time off flows into payroll automatically, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll

citations.quote: It covers the full request lifecycle — from balance checking and submission through admin approval — and payroll integration.
Use the time_off_request_management flow to give admins an embedded approval interface, or call the approve/decline endpoints directly from your own UI.
Decline a pending or approved time off request. Requires an employer_note.
